# Free AI Tokens, Credits and API Trials

> A maintained list of international AI services offering free tokens, credits, API access, coding tools, agents, and multimodal trials, with official references and direct signup links.

Last updated: 2026-07-23

## Primary pages
- English international list: https://yoyoworks.github.io/ai_free_quota/us/
- Complete Chinese list: https://yoyoworks.github.io/ai_free_quota/zh/
- Language landing page: https://yoyoworks.github.io/ai_free_quota/

## Structured data
- Bilingual JSON dataset: https://yoyoworks.github.io/ai_free_quota/ai-free-quotas.json

The English page contains international services only. The Chinese page contains both China-accessible and international services. All entries are generated from one structured source and link to official references.
